interaction: A 30-second 'Squish!' round: SVG cockroaches, huntsmen, termites and mosquitoes scuttle across a kitchen floor; tap or click (or Tab to a bug and press Enter) to splat them for points and combos, with pause and a 'Can't catch them all? Call us.' ending. A still 'spot the 8 bugs' version is the default under reduced motion, and the pest mugshot cards flip to show rap sheets.
notes: The best score is kept only in this browser. The sighting form ends in a demo toast; prices are samples.
